messages:
sam: Quick handoff — I'm OOO starting now until Friday. Can someone collect the saved logsearch queries and dashboard links we should hand to the support rotation for EU + AP-SG model routes (esp gen-xl / gen-v2)? Need p95 latency, 5xx/429 hunt queries, and KV-cache miss snippets. Ping if you own any of these.

mira: I can start a list. Main dashboards are in Logs -> Dashboards: https://logs.redwood.ai/dashboards/eu-gen-overview and https://logs.redwood.ai/dashboards/ap-sg-gen-overview. Saved searches I usually use: `ops/eu-genxl-5xx-30m`, `ops/ap-sg-gen-p95-1h`, `kvcache/eu-gen-misses`.

jason: Adding quick query snippets — drop these into LogSearch quick bar or save as a preset.

```
# EU gen-xl 5xx last 30m
org:acme route:eu-gen model:gen-xl status:[500 TO 599] @timestamp:>now-30m | stats count() by status, route

# AP-SG p95 latency last 1h
region:ap-sg route:gen* | percentile(latency_ms, 95) by route

# KV cache misses (prefix)
org:* route:gen* kv_cache_hit:false | stats count() as misses by model, route | sort misses desc
```

priya: For alert tuning: the eu-genxl 5xx alert's threshold is too tight for some noisy downstream 502s. Suggest change from 2%->4% over 5m and add a cooldown 10m. Also add a secondary alert on error rate by status bucket to avoid paging for single-status flaps.

sam: @priya can you paste exact Alert ID and recommendation? will include in handoff doc.

priya: Alert ID: alerts.europe.genxl.5xx.v2. My suggested rule text: "increase threshold to 4% over 5m, add 10m suppression; add companion alert alerts.europe.genxl.5xx-trend for rate-of-change > 50% over 10m to catch spikes."

mira: For saved views, teams should subscribe to these: `ops/eu-gen-overview`, `ops/ap-sg-gen-p95`, `kvcache/eu-prefix-misses`. I can create an index doc in Confluence with copy-paste queries + links.

ops-bot: Reminder: deploy to eu-gen-v2 happened at 2026-03-15T03:12Z (deploy-3212). If you want to filter by deploy tag: tag:deploy-3212 route:eu-gen-v2

sam: Great. @jason @tony can one of you own the Confluence handoff and add a short runbook (who to ping, links, saved searches, alert IDs, and downgrade criteria)? Prefer simple checklists so oncall can follow quickly.

jason: I'll own it. Creating page now and will add the queries + alerts + dashboard links. I'll also add a short troubleshooting snippet for KV-cache: how to correlate cache misses with model version and client prefix.

tony: Quick note for runbook: include this quick troubleshooting command to fetch recent traces for a route in case latency looks high:

```
# tracer query for traces with p95 > 300ms
service:inference route:eu-gen trace_duration:>300ms @timestamp:>now-15m | top 50 trace_id
```

mira: I'll also share the savedsearch JSON exports for the queries above so support can import them straight into their UI.

sam: Perfect — thanks all. Leaving my contact in case of emergency: sam@redwood.ai. If anything urgent, escalate to priy a and jason.

jason: Page created: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/EU+AP-SG+Gen+Handoff — added saved queries, dashboard links, alert notes, and quick troubleshooting steps. Marking owners on each item.

priya: Reviewed the page, left a few inline comments about thresholds. Looks good to ship to rotation. :thumbsup:
